reproduction: On Windows 10 at 200% DPI, the dark comments dialog initially showed a broad pale area above the player footer. Shrinking the main window from 1400px to 1200px high removed it.
observedIsolation: Removing ThemeShadow did not remove the pale area.
Recreating the dialog acrylic brush did not remove it.
Replacing the footer background with an opaque dark brush removed it without resizing.
Using the native translucent LayerFillColorDefaultBrush also removed it on the first open.
fix: Use LayerFillColorDefaultBrush for the full-width player footer instead of the low-alpha white CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush. Keep the existing dialog acrylic, shadow, separator policy and dismissal behavior.
limitations: Native screenshots show the development candidate with the same footer resource change; the final 0.3.4.4 published files were checked separately.
Pixel samples describe this synthetic scene on this machine, not an arbitrary-background brightness requirement.
No installed user package was replaced locally and no remote comments were sent.
